company.name: AlgoUniversity
company.shortDescription: AlgoUniversity is a job-driven virtual education hub that trains Indian university students to become software engineers.
company.description: AlgoUniversity is building live teaching infrastructure that enables a handful of top educators (from Google, Facebook, etc) to coach a large number of students. AlgoUniversity trains college students in year-long live cohorts and in return, they pay the company a portion of their salary as fees once they get a tech job via an Income Sharing Agreement.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $1,376,209 to $3,486,629, a 2.53x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 68 (+0 over 90 days) and market heat at 78 (-2).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
